scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix ./client" "npm run dev --prefix ./server"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
